scope: Indexed full-input and result validation in Float64 Motan kernels; scalar integer and mixed implementation unchanged
tests:
✔ Motan derivative, integral, norms and kinematic combinations retain original Python numerical order (12.154955ms)
✔ Motan smoothing preserves ties-to-even windows and original asymmetric edge weights (1.058242ms)
✔ Motan integral uses compensated Float64 mean and keeps zip truncation without mutating source (0.313333ms)
✔ Motan numeric kernels reject undefined samples, invalid resolution and nonfinite output (0.311843ms)
✔ captured math references reject changed inputs and return independent values (4.327778ms)
✔ every archived CPython case has an intact bounded record and nonoverlapping archive range (148.110922ms)
✔ known mixed arithmetic matches Python operand conversion, result types and Float64 bits (35.891488ms)
✔ mixed arithmetic requires known types, checks both conversions and keeps result budgets (0.746808ms)
✔ typed mixed status differences, derivatives and CoreXY work through worker and no-Python CSV (358.98114ms)
✔ status type mode does not misclassify unannotated raw integer datasets as floats (317.303038ms)
✔ integer integral retains exact mean division and CPython mixed sum transition order (11.447897ms)
✔ integral reference deltas remain exact before float scaling, including mixed endpoints in typed mode (1.180363ms)
✔ integral rejects ambiguous mixed sums, invalid resources and overflow without returning partial data (0.727798ms)
✔ typed integer and mixed integral flow through worker and no-Python CSV matching original Python (371.331799ms)
✔ scalar arithmetic matches Python types and bits across integer cancellation and boolean series (5.465791ms)
✔ scalar kernels reject ambiguous integer/float provenance, overflow, invalid input and result budgets (0.524056ms)
✔ worker mixed analysis preserves exact residual types through chained derivatives (290.758705ms)
✔ optimized numeric combinations preserve signed zero, overflow order and full-tail validation (0.730068ms)
✔ scalar norm squares integers before ordered float accumulation and matches Python bits (16.913668ms)
✔ scalar norm rejects invalid shapes, individual and accumulated overflow and output over budget (0.643837ms)
✔ integer norm flows through worker, downstream derivative and no-Python CSV with original Python results (297.418929ms)
✔ integer smoothing preserves exact weighting, sequential float sums, half-even windows and truncated edges (18.09031ms)
✔ integer smoothing bounds work, result allocation and each conversion or accumulation overflow (0.726728ms)
✔ integer smoothing supports worker chains and no-Python CSV with original exporter results (289.278969ms)
